patches.summary: Keeps the original Client2 render region full-screen and overlays a bounded 1920x1080 intent-first shell with four surfaces, four natural scenes, reducer-owned HVAC/Seat controls, and a seven-phase observable execution timeline.
Requests the Runtime signature permission and declares explicit Runtime package visibility without INTERNET or cleartext access.
Uses a one-line MainActivity hook to install the maintained Java CockpitControlCoordinator immediately after setContentView.

Embeds SessionClient, generated Session/Event AIDL parcelables, immutable HMI/HVAC/Seat/execution-timeline state and targets, four-surface reducer, bounded typed-event projection, 300 ms HVAC/Seat debounce, governed manual Sessions, existing-Session resume, a 14-alias canonical ID map and the unused legacy compatibility wrapper; the output is signed with the Runtime debug signer.

non_goals: production direct NPU or model access from app UI
tracked_deviations: DEV-017: APK reverse demo path remains a test integration path rather than a vendor source-tree build
DEV-051: two-segment UI aliases remain a compatibility boundary; the legacy static lifecycle owner is retired
DEV-052: the app-private text-free recreation checkpoint is not a production encrypted HMI state store
DEV-053: the fixed 1920x1080 safe frame and unavailable projections are not a production multi-display HMI or vehicle readback
DEV-054: the frozen Session V1 HVAC1 utterance compatibility carrier is not a versioned typed parameter transport
DEV-055: the frozen Session V1 SEAT1 utterance compatibility carrier is not a versioned typed parameter or approval transport
DEV-056: the HMI timeline supports typed execution projection while the current Runtime publishes Session events only
